Class StripeService

public without sharing class StripeService

Service class to manage Stripe transactions. Processes Stripe export payment files and manages the synchronization of transaction data between Stripe CSV exports and Salesforce records. Handles file parsing, data transformation, and linking transactions to payments.

Group:
    Service Classes

Since:
    07/11/2021

Version:
    2.7


Change Log

  • 07/11/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 07/13/2021 - v1.1 - Added support for integers and negative numbers.
  • 08/02/2021 - v1.2 - Updated API to version 61.0.
  • 09/02/2024 - v1.3 - Method Tools.getFieldMapping() replaced by FieldMappingSelector.getFieldSet().
  • 10/27/2025 - v1.4 - LinkStripeTr0ansactionsToPayments and AssignReferences: Services default to processing transactions without payments when no Ids are provided.
  • 11/01/2025 - v1.5 - Database cursor defined in class StripeTransactionProcessor so it can be scheduled using the AsyncFramework.
  • 11/07/2025 - v2.0 - Added finalizer class StriperTransactionProcessExecutor to manage the sequential execution of Stripe transaction processing jobs.
    • Added queueable class GetStripeBalanceTransactions to retrieve detailed balance transaction information from the Stripe API for processed transactions.
  • 11/08/2025 - v2.5 - LinkStripeTransactionsToPayments: Now sets the processing fee from Stripe on the payment record when linking transactions.
- New class SyncStripeCharges to orchestrate the synchronization of historical Stripe charges.
  • 11/10/2025 - v2.6 - New method JobBuilder.withDelay() accepts Integer for setting a custom delay in minutes.
  • 04/12/2026 - v2.7 - Migrated CSV classes (CsvReader, CsvLine) from Tools to CsvUtils. Updated API to version 66.0.
